current.text: Charlotte traded him to Phoenix for Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale.
He is the projected starting power forward in Phoenix.
The Suns hope his ball handling, rim pressure and catch-and-shoot threes take pressure off Devin Booker.
He shares the ball with Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks and Collin Gillespie.
Experts expect Booker, Green and Brooks to be ahead of him in usage, so he should lose value in Phoenix.
Experts call him a bust at his market price. A rank near 100 is 20 to 30 spots too high, pick 89 is too early, and an ESPN rank near 80 is a wasted pick.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an ankle injury.

durable.text: His best production came when LaMelo Ball and Brandon Miller were injured and his usage went up. His minutes shrank late last season when he was asked to scale back.
He only puts up strong numbers as the number one option with high usage.
His athleticism and his finishing at the rim have declined over the last three years.
He shot 33% from three last season.
Experts call him a poor shooter whose three-point shot was only good in one outlier season.
He adds few steals and blocks.

note: Bridges sits on the edge of our 144-player pool: Yahoo ranks him 101 and ESPN 78, and both price him at only 3 to 5 USD. Our league paid 11 USD for him last season, but every recent expert note calls him a bust behind Booker, Green and Brooks. He projects for about 18 points, 2.1 threes and 84% FT, but he hurts FG% and steals and does not clearly fit any punt build. Do not pay more than a few USD. If you draft him, check his ankle (Yahoo Q) and his shot share in Phoenix in the first two weeks, and drop him if his usage shrinks.
